title: Italian-Style Algerian Tagine
description: A fusion of Italian and North African flavors, this dish combines the tender taste of chicken with the vibrant spices of the tagine. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken with the Algerian tagine spice blend.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned, then remove from heat.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté the onion until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potato and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and cover.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
